answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 8763 Country: Canada Title: What is the maximum amount of time that a person can go without bathing in order to maintain cleanliness and hygiene? Question: What is the maximum amount of time that a person can go without bathing in order to maintain cleanliness and hygiene? Answer ID: 8763 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2191/1780=B/1429) If the ghusl is obligatory, he can remain in the same condition of impurity until the time of a salah arrives. But, it is better to get pure by having ghusl as soon as possible. However, it is sunnah to have ghusl once in a week on Friday. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
